parsed.why: Worst-policies tier: K-12 bathroom ban extended 2025, narrow misdemeanour for trans facility use with a minor present, no state gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime protection, religious healthcare refusal, X marker rescinded. Less broad than airport-wide facility bans.

Strongest local layer: gender-identity anti-discrimination since 2018, hate-crime enhancement 2019, panic defence abolished, documented civil-rights enforcement against an attacker, no bathroom ban. Care bans and raw incident count are resident-facing or denominator-free.

Harshest traveller exposure: criminal-trespass facility law covering airports, parks, universities, with a documented arrest; licence marker treated as fraud; care restrictions reach adults; official travel advisories. State-imposed universal exposure, no working remedy.

Low-Risk group, no bathroom ban, gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime enhancement since 2013, marker change on provider statement. Protections predate national posture; no documented enforcement data, but no local hostile facility layer.

Worst-laws-passed tier: school facility ban and sex-by-birth statute, religious-refusal law licensing service denial, hostile name-change ruling, no gender-identity protections. Vs dossier 3, lacks airport-wide criminal facility enforcement and adult care barriers.
